page.overview:
What is Aleaxtis?

Aleaxtis (), also known as the Kingdom of the Sahuagin,

This kingdom occupied the eastern leg of the Alamber Sea, which made up a large portion of that sea,

The exact location of the kingdom was a mystery to the surface dwellers of the Old Empires, though they mistakenly believed it to lay somewhere north of the Ship of the Gods.

The kingdom of Aleaxtis was founded in the year , by the sahuagin T'Raam. His reign would go on for 297 years.
